## Description

Formulates portfolio weights by minimizing the worst-case expected utility over an ambiguity set defined via the Wasserstein distance around the empirical return distribution.

## Where it may fit

High parameter uncertainty, model misspecification, out-of-sample stress testing during tail-risk events.

## Vehicles

Institutional asset management, risk parity funds, quantitative endowment portfolios.

## Required data

Historical asset returns, empirical covariance matrices, Wasserstein ball radius ambiguity parameters.

## Caveats

Solves convex optimization problems that can become computationally intensive for large asset universes.
